1.content: When evaluating a candidate move, if it lands on a hazard cell assign a -1,000,000 penalty and stop scoring that move. If the move reduces the Manhattan distance to any hazard, add an additional -30,000 penalty. Apply these safety penalties before any positive bonuses (e.g., goal‑progress).

3.content: Add a positive bonus proportional to the reduction in Manhattan distance to the goal; larger distance reductions receive larger bonuses.
